name: Connected Media Technologies, Inc.
summary: Connected Media Technologies, Inc. provides integrated sales, communications, and marketing solutions across various media platforms. The company offers strategic planning, consulting, custom publishing, collateral development, proprietary programs, sales promotions, and digital and multi-media initiatives. It serves clients in the energy, financial, tourism, and health industries, as well as companies, international governments, and U.S. federal agencies in the United States, Latin America, and Europe. The company was formerly known as Natcom Marketing International, Inc. and changed its name to Connected Media Technologies, Inc. in July 2006. It was founded in 1982 and is based in Miami, Florida.
